notes.title: Patch notes V0.1.12
notes.content:
ADDITIONS
Added an "All" button to the Quintessence menu

Map can now be toggled between "Small." "Large," and "Off"

Added "Reflective Water" Rite to Doll's Shop. One time enemy analysis items.

Added a progression block in Dis, a key is now required to progress to the Back Alley. This was meant to encourage the player to explore the lower level areas first.

Subject to change.

Added an array of new items to the Quintessence shop in the area to better show what the system can do.

Mascot Charm - If the user strikes a weakpoint, apply \[Aggression] to the user.

\[Aggression]: Gain an extra action on the next turn. Does not stack.

Devil Tongue - Increases chance of Flesh skills dropping items.

Yellow Bile - \[Poisoned] has a chance to apply \[Attack DOWN], \[Defense DOWN], or \[Speed DOWN].

Blessed Inhaler - Increases the amount of Stamina (ST) restored by Rest.

Morbid Charm - When \[Rest] is used, apply \[Defense Up].

Fluffy Pillow - When \[Rest] is used, apply \[Attack Up].

Lidless Thermos - \[Frozen] enemies take increased fire damage; \[Burning] enemies take increased ice damage

Knife Sharpener - Metal attacks have an increased chance of inflicting \[Bleeding]
CHANGES
Moved location of the Apartments to the Docks.

UI changes.
FIXES
Fixed an issue where a demon would leave combat in a group during communion, and the battle theme would fail to resume.

Fixed the broken items in the Lizard Woman Communion route. She now gives the Quintessence \[Abyssal Magazine].

Fixed a progression break in the Leo/Jersey quest line.

Text during the fight against Stare no longer auto-progresses.

Fixed a bug that caused the item crystal behind the fake wall in Lower Dis to not give anything. It now gives \[Warm Broach].

Fixed the effects on certain status effects to properly reflect description.

Fixed broken skills.

Fixed Typos

notes.title: The Home Stretch
notes.content:
Coming in 2025!
Now clocking 2 years longer than initially planned, They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith is in the home stretch of development!

What was once intended to be a small free prequel has blossomed into a standalone title that feels worthy of a price tag. We estimate the game will take the average player about 8 hours to beat (closer to 5h if they're absolutely flying through it, and 10h+ if they take their time exploring every corner).

We'll be sure to announce a release date and final price here once that has been set. We don't want to make the same mistake twice, blowing past a publicly set date. But we're feeling VERY good about a 2025 launch!!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/4a4e34f7fdce0c715aa5dd051f279b0a2e9bc8f5.png"]
UI Improvements
After much playtesting the UI has continued to evolve a great deal. Micro improvements along the way have made it both easier to navigate, while also giving it more of a prestige feel. It looks and functions in a way that now feels like it does justice to the game that influenced TSFTA. At least, that's the hope!

Here's a quick look at how things have changed over the last year:
1 year ago
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/6f9663d8979c614f6a1ab591fb05c1df0f26acb2.png"]
Today
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/a0e14c429e4fd023f180d5aac0c99e3a994a0ca5.png"]
Demonic Communion
A major mechanic in They Speak is being able to "Commune" with any monster you fight. Not all of them are willing to chat at length. But many have full dialogue trees, and special interactions than can only be found by chatting with them.

With 50+ demonic enemies in Zenith, writing unique Communions for them all was becoming a major bottleneck. A new writer, probskay, was brought in to help with this process and a lot of progress has been made as a result!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/929756c33d1d2f0a8c7babc92bd7e610f6b84bd9.png"]
Updated Demo (Coming Soon)
Thank you for taking this journey along with us. I love working on these weird games in this weird little world, and I'm very excited to get the games in your hands. After Zenith is done, I will be taking a small break, then returning full force to get They Speak proper done. Posts about that will be much more frequent than Zenith posts have been. 

We're in the last bit of Zenith's development, and the game will be shown off in a few showcases over the next couple months so that's a lot to get excited about! Since the game is much closer to the end of its development time, we're going to launch another demo build showing the game in a mostly finished state. Keep an eye out for that.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/"][/dynamiclink]And as always. If you'd like to both help with the game and be notified of launch, please be sure to add it to your Wishlist!

notes.title: Aug 2024 Development Update
notes.content:
UPDATE
Crazy as it sounds, we've crossed over 1 YEAR since Zenith was originally slated to release...

Nikki has been running monthly updates over on the Kickstarter page. As those are limited to backers of the main game, we thought it was high time we ran a new update on the Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

WHAT HAPPENED?
There isn't really any one single thing that slowed down the production of Zenith. This projected was begun as a trial to iron out any kinks ahead of tackling the FULL release.

Piece by piece, as Zenith was added to and improved upon, it would shine a spotlight on other areas that were no longer up to par. Often this sort of revisionist approach would be the death of a game. But this was done by design here! Even if our estimates on the timeline were significantly off...

Through private playtests, attending events, and any other feedback that could be gathered - it became much more clear where work was needed, all while laying the groundwork for the final title!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/68a87c9d501cb9d624bfc295fc19a5577eb88408.png
WHAT'S CHANGED?
As a breakdown since you last heard from us:

 Nikki spent some time honing her 3D modeling, and was able to give the game a MAJOR update on visuals
 The choice was made to drop the 4:3 ratio (which also meant redoing a bunch of UI and other art) as can be seen in the all new screenshots!
 The combat was overhauled to be more interesting
 The UI was completely redone
 Cutscene revisions
 Dialogue rewrites
 Endless bug fixes and improvements to how the game renders and runs!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/6f9663d8979c614f6a1ab591fb05c1df0f26acb2.png
RELEASE?
While we're still not quite ready to set a new launch date, the game is well underway, with a brand new demo nearing completion!

We also officially moved the main THEY SPEAK game back to "2025".
While a lot of the foundations will already be laid through Zenith, it is a MUCH larger title. So development will be notably faster, but is still anticipated to be a lengthy process!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075460/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss/

There is art on that page that is already over 2 years old!!
When we're ready to launch Zenith, we'll be sure that page receives a revision to reflect the changes in style and gameplay.

Thank you all for your patience!
I'm confident it will be well worth the wait - especially for all you lovely Kickstarter backers who are now getting TWO games for the price of one ;)

-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Demo available NOW!
notes.content:
PUBLIC DEMO
They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith has it's first public demo available NOW!
Here is a presskit for any creators who want to give this game a whirl.

This game has improved by leaps and bounds the last few months, and we feel it is finally ready for a public debut. This whole journey started nearly 2 years ago with the release of a demo. The interest shown in that simple build encouraged us to pursue a Kickstarter campaign, that funded the next stage of development!

Zenith is a standalone prequel, featuring a separate protagonist, story and events from the full They Speak From The Abyss game - setting the stage for the upcoming full release!

[previewyoutube=9QsIFZymjck;full][/previewyoutube]
WHAT NEXT?
Development has been happening behind closed doors for a long time now, doing our very best as a small team of 3 to playtest this game and polish it as thoroughly as possible. The game is very much still under active development, and the feedback we receive at this time will be invaluable for finishing Zenith, carrying forward to the full game.

Please drop your bug/crash reports over in this Steam discussion thread.

After the Next Fest, we will be drawing out an internal roadmap towards release, and will hold off on announcing a release date until we're 100% confident it will be achievable. Much of the important mechanical work is already in place, so we expect development to hit a nice healthy stride again after this event.

CALL TO ACTION
The #1 thing you can do to help us at this time, would be add both Zenith and the full TSFTA to your Steam Wishlist. This lets Steam know people are interested, and can help grant us wider visibility around the store. Thank you all SO much for your support!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075460/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss/

notes.title: Realms Deep 2023 & Development Update
notes.content:
REALMS DEEP 2023
We are thrilled to have Zenith chosen to take part in Realms Deep 2023! This project has always been rather niche. So having an event as prominent and well regarded as Realms Deep single us out is both incredibly flattering, and motivating!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163707/053a529d3eb9c00b757e16db5d238f4c71a59835.png

We fully intended to have a playable version available for this event. Our apologies to anyone who landed on this page from the "Games with Demos" category. I don't think there's any way to drop out of that list at this stage?? The why is a bit longer of a story...

DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
Zenith is a standalone Prequel to They Speak From The Abyss. This isn't a glorified demo, uploaded as a "Prologue", which has become a rather common developer trick here on Steam. While Zenith features locations and character from the Main Game, it is fully it's own game and experience!

Zenith will no longer be free
Our initial decision to make this Prequel available for Free was made when the game was a fraction of it's current size. Zenith was originally conceived 7 MONTHS ago!! The project has grown a LOT since then! As an example, the game now features over 50 unique monsters, and 30 originals tracks in the OST.

With a growing scope, a challenging move to a new city mid-development, followed by Unity fully melting down - we had to re-evaluate a lot of things. It was decided that development will continue in Unity (starting over would be too costly), but not after weeks spent agonizing over whether that was still feasible. Especially when Free releases could potentially end up costing money to release with Unity's new Runtime Fee. That situation is a mess...

It took quite some time to come to terms with it - but Zenith will now be a paid release. We promise the price tag on this game won't break the bank! It will likely be somewhere close to $5 at launch.

No release date is set - and unfortunately due to missing our original release target, we are unable to change it to anything other than the "Coming Soon" you currently see. A demo is in the works, and will be announced on Nikki's twitter as soon as it's available! And be sure to Wishlisht the full game so you are notified for it's full release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)
